sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For generations, our foundry has valued the strong connections we build with our business partners. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable planning stability for both our companies. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to offer €51.30 for the extended 24-month term. 

To set out our full Angebot clearly, we propose a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Please note that this offer stays valid 30 days. We look forward to continuing our collaboration with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move closer to a mutual agreement. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

In recognition of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession and offer a price of €50.80 per unit. This price reflects the value of the 24-month contract while ensuring the high quality you expect from our foundry. 

Please understand that our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For this complete Angebot, we propose a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement towards a mutual agreement between our companies. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.50 per unit. 

This price represents a fair balance for the 24-month contract term. Under our adjusted Angebot, we offer a price of €50.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We take great pride in our foundry, our skilled people, and the strong regional ties we have shared with your company over many years. It is always a pleasure to work together towards solutions that serve us both well.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We look forward to reaching a mutual agreement soon and continuing our successful work together.
